fields.name: Entities
fields.evidence: NoesisGameUI.dll+0x421CD0 (Toolkit, ActivateVMCharacterSystem::ProcessCharacterDeferredActivation, EntityView<VMCharacterActivatedSingletonComponent, VMCharacterDeferredActivationSingletonComponent>): tests the size at +0xC, then walks the buffer at +0 with stride 8 (end = base + size*8) as ls::SpanIterator<ls::ID<ecs::EntityHandleTraits>> (assert string), and removes entries by index (FUN_1802e4be0) once found in a HashSet of entities. Registry size 16 = Array (pointer, capacity +8, size +0xC); live: heap pointer at +0, capacity 2..0x40 at +8, size always 0 at +0xC.

summary: Client UI: character entities whose VMCharacter activation was postponed; ActivateVMCharacterSystem retries them each frame and drops them when done. Singleton from game start (idle, level-change); the array was always empty in samples.
open_questions: Writer (who appends to the array) not read; element type taken from the reader's SpanIterator<ID<EntityHandleTraits>>.
